measurements.scope: Conditional geographic floor between nominal 47°N and eastern 58°N sections identified as North Atlantic Current by Caínzos et al. (2023). Station latitudes deviate from nominal sections; the northern section combines western 53°N and eastern 58°N portions. Cruises, sampled branches and density layers differ. No simultaneous connected axis, common fixed layer or actual geographic endpoints inferred. Not a whole-current length or guaranteed physical minimum.
measurements.source_locator: Sections 2 and 3.1.10; nominal NAC sections at 47°N and eastern 58°N; OSW WGS84 latitude separation

map_features.note: Approximate editorial locator points place a name in a recognizable region on the OSW equirectangular map. Points are neither observed cores nor endpoints or length measurements. Multi-basin family names have one point per basin and must be split into separate records before quantitative comparison.
map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: NOAA glossary regional continuation from the vicinity of 40 degrees N, 50 degrees W southeast of Grand Banks toward the western approaches of the British Isles. OSW chooses a nominal terminal gate west of Ireland, with southern/northern approach alternatives. Excludes Gulf Stream upstream, branches toward Iceland, the onward Norwegian/Canary flows and recirculation. A selected approach route is not the length of the entire branching Gulf Stream System.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

ordering_sensitivity.interpretation: Conservative positions within retained rounded route envelopes, treating choices independently; touching envelopes overlap. Not a statistical rank interval or a uniform whole-current comparison.

widths.boundary_rule: Section 2.3: station pairs selected by consistent slope of eastward accumulated horizontal mass transport; vertical extent by the same integrated flow direction. No fixed speed cutoff or instantaneous velocity envelope inferred.
widths.extraction_method: Publisher XLSX cells retained and distance transcribed directly; explicit section/cruise join. No map or longitude-to-distance conversion.
widths.geographic_scope: North Atlantic Current 47∘ N; source longitude limits -49.6:-44.4 degrees east. Section track may deviate from nominal latitude near boundaries. Endpoint latitudes remain unextracted.
widths.layer: Publisher neutral-density layer indices 1:6; reported depth extent 0 to 838 m. Density surfaces are not a uniform fixed-depth slice.
widths.name: North Atlantic Current
widths.range_interpretation: Publisher Table 2 distance rounded to kilometres. Width uncertainty is not reported. Transport uncertainty is a separate quantity. Separate cruises and layers are not an annual range.
